newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dai-Ichi Securities to dissolve Swiss subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Dai-Ichi Securities to dissolve Swiss subsidiary.

text.p: Dai-Ichi Securities Co Ltd said on Monday that it has decided to dissolve its Swiss subsidiary due to the unit's sluggish business performance.
The Japanese brokerage's wholly owned subsidiary, Dai-Ichi (Switzerland) Ltd, capitalised at 10 million Swiss francs, will stop operating on Monday, the brokerage said in a statement.
The Swiss unit has been providing services to European investors, such as the trading of Japanese stocks, the statement said.
Dai-Ichi Securities expects to post an extraordinary loss of 990 million yen in the year to March 1998 from dissolving the unit.
